messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SRV lookup error spike for service 'scheduler' in us-west-2c — 15% SRV failures over 5m. Pager routed to samir (oncall). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/dns-srv
samir (oncall): taking this. thanks. quick status check: is this limited to us-west-2c or broader?
jessica: I see srv failures from multiple k8s clusters in us-west-2c. dig from a worker: ```$ dig @10.10.2.5 _scheduler._tcp.service.consul SRV +short
# no output (timeout)
```
jessica: coredns pods are returning SERVFAIL a lot. logs show repeated "read udp 10.10.2.5: random > 10.10.2.53: i/o timeout" entries.
networking-sre: we had an AZ peering route flap at ~2026-03-15T10:12:xxZ (BGP flapped for ~90s). After that, egress NAT gateways in us-west-2c show conntrack growth and high retrans counts. conntrack_count: 180k on nat-egress-1 (threshold 200k).
samir (oncall): ok — hypothesis: DNS forwarders/consul upstreams are overloaded / responses dropped due to conntrack. mitigation plan from runbook: 1) scale coredns replicas 2) restart one coordinator node 3) add temporary SRV fallback to A records via service policy. i'll execute steps 1+2.
jessica: scaling coredns to 6 replicas now: ```kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy coredns --replicas=6``` scaling confirmed, new pods spinning up (pod/coredns-5 ready, pod/coredns-6 still initializing)
samir (oncall): i'm cordoning and restarting kube-proxy on a noisy node (k8s-worker-12) that shows conntrack saturation: ```kubectl drain k8s-worker-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` will restart kube-proxy and check conntrack after.
eng-lead: any customer-visible errors so far? impact to Hosted API or Dedicated customers?
jessica: early telemetry: API gateway for three Hosted customers in us-west-2c saw increased 502s correlating with SRV lookup latency spike. Dedicated clusters with local consul had elevated metadata-service errors but some requests retried successfully. customer-impact: limited to customers pinned to us-west-2c, ~3 customers showing higher error rates; support alerted.
networking-sre: pushing a temporary egress rule to direct DNS traffic for consul upstreams to us-west-2a via static NAT to avoid the overloaded nat-egress-1. Applying iptables NAT rewrite on the egress router now. Will monitor for asymmetric path regressions.
samir (oncall): after restart of k8s-worker-12, conntrack_count dropped to 42k on that host. coredns logs show fewer i/o timeouts. pushing service routing fallback next: updating service mesh config to allow A-record fallback for scheduler (TTL low) — patching consul template.
jessica: applied consul service-template fallback: ```consul config write -<<EOF
{
  "Kind": "service-defaults",
  "Name": "scheduler",
  "Defaults": { "Connect": { "Proxy": { "LocalService": {"FallbackToARecords": true}}}}
}
EOF

``` applied, policy rolled out to 80% nodes.
samir (oncall): monitoring: SRV error rate dropped from 15% -> 2% in 8 minutes. API 502s also trending down. keeping elevated scans for 60m.
eng-lead: good. please create a customer-impact summary and include mitigation steps & timeline for postmortem. mark incident severity accordingly.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Handed off to follow-up runbook. Incident channel created: #postmortem-3032109876
jessica: note for postmortem: root cause likely conntrack pressure on NAT egress after AZ peering flap causing UDP packet drops to consul upstreams; secondary factors: low coredns replica count + strict SRV-only resolution policy. recommend: 1) increase default coredns replicas in us-west2 clusters 2) add conntrack autoscaling or tune thresholds on egress fleet 3) implement SRV-to-A fallback in service defaults by policy for critical services 4) alerting: add conntrack high-water alert + SRV failure SLI alarm.
samir (oncall): creating postmortem ticket now and will include timelines / commands executed. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
networking-sre: will file a cloud support case for the peering fabric flap and request deeper telemetry for NAT queueing.
incident-bot: Pager cleared for samir (oncall). If any regressions, re-open or page oncall. Logs & traces archived to https://observability.redwood.local/incident/3032109876
